text.autoconfig.pulse.title: Pulse Adaptive Performance
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.enabled.too: Master switch. Turns off all monitoring and adaptation when disabled.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.targetFps.t: The frame rate Pulse tries to keep you near. Stage decisions are based on how far your real FPS is from this.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.logStageCha: Print a line to the log whenever the adaptive stage changes. Useful for tuning thresholds.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.adaptiveEna: Lets Pulse change stages automatically based on FPS. Turn off to stay locked at Optimal.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.cooldownSec: Minimum time between stage changes. Higher values stop the system from flickering between stages.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.minRenderDi: Render distance used at the Aggressive stage, in chunks.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.maxRenderDi: Render distance used at the Optimal stage, in chunks.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.minSimulati: Simulation distance used at the Aggressive stage, in chunks.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.maxSimulati: Simulation distance used at the Optimal stage, in chunks.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.lightThresh: Enter the Light stage once FPS drops below this percentage of your target FPS.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.moderateThr: Enter the Moderate stage once FPS drops below this percentage of your target FPS.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.aggressiveT: Enter the Aggressive stage once FPS drops below this percentage of your target FPS.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.recoveryThr: FPS must climb back above this percentage of target before Pulse eases off to a lighter stage. Stops rapid flickering.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.forcedStage: Lock Pulse to a specific stage for testing. Set to Auto for normal behaviour.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.rollingWind: How far back Pulse looks when averaging FPS and frame time. Shorter reacts faster, longer is smoother.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.lightPartic: Percentage of normal particle limits to allow at the Light stage. Not applied yet.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.moderatePar: Percentage of normal particle limits to allow at the Moderate stage. Not applied yet.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.aggressiveP: Percentage of normal particle limits to allow at the Aggressive stage. Not applied yet.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.lightEntity: Percentage of normal entity render distance to allow at the Light stage. Not applied yet.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.moderateEnt: Percentage of normal entity render distance to allow at the Moderate stage. Not applied yet.
text.autoconfig.pulse.option.aggressiveE: Percentage of normal entity render distance to allow at the Aggressive stage. Not applied yet.
